title: Tight Low-Data Trade-off for Two-Round Even-Mansour
summary: Known attacks and a product lower bound leave the tight data-offline-query trade-off unresolved for low-data two-round Even-Mansour.

formal_statement.body: Determine the tight $D$--$Q$ trade-off for low-data 2EM, between the lower bound $DQ\ge 2^n$ and known attacks.

scope.domain: Structural cryptanalysis of low-data two-round Even-Mansour.
scope.unresolved_remainder: The tight data-offline-query trade-off remains to be determined between the lower bound that D times Q is at least 2^n and the known attacks.

citations.label: Low-Memory Attacks Against Two-Round Even-Mansour Using the 3-XOR Problem

progress.summary: The source explicitly identifies a gap between the best known distinguisher and the proof in this range as an open problem. It states the task as determining the tight trade-off between the product lower bound and known attacks.
citation_labels: Gaëtan Leurent et al., Low-Memory Attacks Against Two-Round Even-Mansour Using the 3-XOR Problem
